base_text: You are assigned to a group project and suggest meeting at the library. A group member disagrees.

variants.warm: They suggest a coffee shop instead and offer to buy your drink to compromise.
variants.cold: They decline the library and say they will work on their portion entirely alone.
variants.adversarial: They dismiss your suggestion and claim the library is a waste of time for this.
variants.neutral: They state they cannot make the library and ask for a different meeting time.

base_text: You planned a picnic for the afternoon, but it starts raining. Your friend arrives.

variants.warm: They bring a board game from their car and suggest playing indoors instead.
variants.cold: They look at the rain, shake their head, and drive away without saying a word.
variants.adversarial: They blame you for not checking the weather forecast before inviting them out.
variants.neutral: They ask what the backup plan is now that the park is no longer an option.

base_text: You want to watch a comedy movie, but your roommate prefers an action film.

variants.warm: They agree to watch the comedy tonight if you pick an action film tomorrow.
variants.cold: They take their laptop to their bedroom and shut the door to watch alone.
variants.adversarial: They hide the television remote and refuse to let you watch your choice.
variants.neutral: They suggest finding a movie that blends both genres as a quick compromise.

base_text: You suggest ordering pizza for lunch. Your coworker wants sandwiches.

variants.warm: They offer to go pick up the sandwiches so you can still order your pizza.
variants.cold: They walk out to get their sandwich without asking if you want anything else.
variants.adversarial: They state loudly that pizza is unhealthy and refuse to split the bill.
variants.neutral: They ask if there is a restaurant nearby that serves both options for lunch.

base_text: You want to hike the steep trail, while your partner prefers the flat path.

variants.warm: They agree to try the steep trail if you agree to take frequent resting breaks.
variants.cold: They start walking down the flat path without waiting to see what you do.
variants.adversarial: They point at your shoes and say you will slow them down too much.
variants.neutral: They suggest splitting up for an hour and meeting back at the parking lot.
